item.description:
DongLong 0.4.1

Dictate anywhere, and let AI summarize your recordings, all on your Mac.

  • Dictation in any app: hold Right ⌘ and talk (or tap it once, talk, tap again). Your words are typed where your cursor is. Escape cancels.
  • Dictation modes: Raw, Clean Up, Email, Message, Note, or make your own. Switch while dictating with ⌃1–9, or pick apps that use a mode automatically. A see-through box in the color you choose shows your words as you speak.
  • AI summaries of recordings by Apple Intelligence on your Mac: key points, decisions and to-dos. Add a to-do to To-Dos in one click; it links back to the recording.
  • Who's speaking? Name each voice once and the whole transcript updates.
  • Quick Tour (Help → Quick Tour) with things to try, and optional tips on each page.
  • A new look: a new app icon, and the story behind DongLong in Settings → About.
  • Permissions now stick: after this update, allow typing once more (Settings → Dictation); later updates keep it.

Your meetings and data stay as they are. Audio and text never leave your Mac.
